notes:
- Product: PR-review assistant + IDE copilot. Primary goal: reduce reviewer time on PRs by 40-60%.
- Requirements: diff-aware summarization, targeted comment suggestions, reranking of automated comments, per-developer personalization, model/version pinning, streaming token-level suggestions in IDE (p50 <100ms).
- Quote from CTO (A. Reynolds): "We need suggestions that understand context across commits and multi-file diffs — not just single-file snippets. Low tail latency in the editor is non-negotiable."
- Deployment preference: Dedicated pool inside VPC for predictable throughput; later consider Private for regulated customers.
- Security: completed basic questionnaire; will need full SOC2 docs + KMS integration for enterprise customers. Data residency discussions ongoing (EU clients).
- Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to reserved capacity if unit cost savings >= 30% vs hosted bursts.
- POC ask: integrate with GitHub org, run on 3 active repos (backend + frontend + infra), produce auto-comments on open PRs + human-in-the-loop acceptance flow.
- Misc links: sample PRs provided: github.com/threadline/repo/pull/341, github.com/threadline/repo/pull/359.
- AE notes: SE demo resonated with dev leads; C-level wants SLA for tail latency before procurement.
- UX note: devs prefer inline suggestions in VS Code via streaming; if streaming unsupported, POC will likely fail.
- Next: send Dedicated sizing worksheet + SOW; schedule infra kick-off week of 2026-03-15.
